when_to_use: intimate bossa nova where a calm surface carries quiet saudade, nylon-guitar batida and straight 16ths supporting a voice that never needs to raise itself, 80-160 BPM

defaults.feel: rhythm section dead straight 16ths (no swing), lead/vocal laid-back or rubato, bass anticipation into chord changes

signature_moves: Jobim chromatic descent: Cmaj7 -> C#dim7 -> Dm7 -> D#dim7 -> C/E -> A7(b9,b13), allowing the floor to move while the melody remains composed
major-dominant II: Fmaj7 -> G7(13) -> Gm9 -> C7(b9), brightening the surface before saudade returns underneath
minor line cliche: Am9 -> Bm7b5 -> E7(b9,b13) -> Am(maj7) -> Am6, used when tenderness should reveal its ache without becoming theatrical
backdoor and tritone color: Cmaj9 -> Fm9 Bb13 -> Cmaj7 -> Db13, creating one elegant detour before the song resumes its calm posture
cadence_options: I-VI-ii-V: Cmaj9 -> A7(b9) -> Dm9 -> G13 G7(b13), shaped as a continuous breath rather than a hard turnaround
tag ending: repeat the last 2 bars three times, each pass more spacious, then let a final 6/9 chord ring without explanation
avoid: plain triads where extended harmony is part of the style vocabulary (see bossa-nova-genre.md SS4)
swinging the rhythm section; only the lead may loosen against the straight grid (see bossa-nova-genre.md SS2/SS8)

hook_archetypes.name: still-note-moving-room
hook_archetypes.rhythm: one held or lightly repeated melody note while the harmony moves beneath it, making restraint feel more expressive than motion
hook_archetypes.contour: minimal pitch movement; the emotional change is carried by the chromatic chord line under the stable voice
hook_archetypes.first_appears: Verse A1 over the first chromatic descent, after the batida has established calm

hook_archetypes.name: phrase-and-batida-reply
hook_archetypes.rhythm: 2 bars of lead melody followed by 2 bars of silence in which guitar rhythm becomes slightly more articulate
hook_archetypes.contour: the guitar answers the melody's rhythmic shape without copying its pitches, like a quiet acknowledgment
hook_archetypes.first_appears: Verse A1, bars 3-4, once the listener understands that silence is part of the conversation

intro.note_lengths: sparse or absent; let the batida introduce the emotional temperature before any voice explains it

verse.note_lengths: sotto voce, mid-length phrases with breath between them; target extensions should feel discovered inside ordinary speech
verse.contour: gentle close-interval movement, with leaps reserved for one line that briefly exposes deeper feeling
verse.placement: laid-back behind the straight rhythm-section grid

bridge.note_lengths: slightly longer phrases as the harmony becomes more active, but never enough to break the intimate scale
bridge.contour: follow altered dominants and modulation with restrained upward motion, allowing one color to linger
bridge.placement: laid-back, with a small lift from pp toward mp

solo.note_lengths: freer phrase edges and selective chromatic passing tones, balanced by audible breath and understatement
solo.contour: sub-tone tenor or flute-like lines that suggest virtuosity without displaying it
solo.placement: rubato phrase edges over an unwavering straight rhythm section

drum_skeleton.low_energy: thin cross-stick shadows the batida, shaker holds constant 16ths, and muted surdo on beat 1 gives the song a floor without calling attention to itself
drum_skeleton.mid_energy: keep the same fundamental density; let a soft surdo accent on beat 3 and slightly clearer percussion interaction create flow rather than expansion
drum_skeleton.high_energy: for up-tempo samba-bossa, add pandeiro or agogo as a brighter surface while preserving straight 16ths and emotional restraint

arrangement_defaults.layout_rules: guitar opens as if the song has already been quietly underway. Shaker and bass enter without announcing a new section; they simply make the room more complete. Lead arrives sotto voce and should never compete with the batida. Counter-melody and pad enter only after the first statement has earned additional color. Let the bridge deepen harmony rather than volume. Re-head with the fullest but still restrained texture, then remove layers during the tag until the final 6/9 chord feels like a thought left in the air.

anti_boredom_rules: the rhythm section must remain straight at every energy level; looseness belongs to the lead, not the foundation
lead phrases and guitar responses must alternate foreground so intimacy is created through listening, not continuous filling
use at least one signature_move and make it coincide with a meaningful melodic hold, breath, or change of register
the bridge must create genuine harmonic distance from the verse without becoming louder or stylistically heavier
dynamics remain restrained for most of the form; the emotional peak should come from harmony, register, or exposure rather than force

bass_behavior.rhythmic_relationship: supports batida with root on beat 1, chord tone near beat 3, and anticipation into changes
bass_behavior.articulation: short warm acoustic notes with clear separation

groove_intent.feel: straight-sixteenth bossa pulse with a laid-back lead
groove_intent.kick: soft surdo-like pulse rather than a drum-kit backbeat
groove_intent.ensemble_relationship: guitar, bass, and percussion remain straight while lead phrases float behind

distinguishing_traits: straight rhythm section with only the lead laying back
chromatic AABA harmony and restrained saudade dynamic
